## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing. (e.g., "I find it difficult to...")

## Serverless & Privacy Alignment
Setu P2P operates strictly in the user's browser without central signaling servers or cloud databases:
- How will this feature function purely on the client side using WebRTC DataChannels or browser APIs?
- Does this feature maintain local-first data ownership and require user consent?

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or mockups about the feature request here.
